User_Objective: Understand what is required and why.
Case_Manager: Coordinate unresolved context and specialist input.
Product_Rules: Prepare a versioned requirements set with policy references and unresolved questions. Use approved policy versions; unknown applicability becomes an exception.
Handoff_Dependency: Ask Legal about non-AML requirements when needed.
Pain_or_Value: Value hypothesis: Understand what is required and why.
Root_Cause_Hypothesis: Policy context and rationale may be fragmented.
Human_Boundary: MVP: confirm the requirements set. Target: standard execution only within approved authority; exceptions go to the designated expert.

User_Objective: Reuse evidence before asking the client again.
Client_RM: No additional request until available evidence is checked.
KYC_Operations: Search approved sources and record relevant evidence.
Product_Rules: Retrieve permitted evidence and attach source, retrieval time and entity match. Use authorised sources and access controls; no unrestricted collection.
Systems_Evidence: External registries, data providers and evidence repository
Handoff_Dependency: Sourcing result goes to evidence/gap review.
Pain_or_Value: Value hypothesis: Reuse evidence before asking the client again.
Root_Cause_Hypothesis: Source access and evidence context may be fragmented.
Human_Boundary: MVP: review suggested entity matches and reuse. Target: ambiguous matches or access restrictions escalate.

User_Objective: See what is still missing and what blocks progress.
Client_RM: Avoid repeat requests for already available evidence.
Product_Rules: Match evidence to requirements and propose a residual-gap list with owners and reasons. Unknown evidence sufficiency stays open; never infer that missing evidence is acceptable.
Handoff_Dependency: Unresolved interpretation goes to the designated reviewer.
Pain_or_Value: Value hypothesis: See what is still missing and what blocks progress.
Root_Cause_Hypothesis: Requirements and evidence may not share a consistent link.
Human_Boundary: MVP: confirm the residual-gap list. Target: complex information gaps require human judgment.

User_Objective: Receive one clear request explaining the remaining information needed.
Client_RM: Provide requested documents or explain why they are unavailable.
Case_Manager: Coordinate communications and follow-up; role split to validate.
KYC_Operations: Specify the missing evidence and explain the requirement.
Product_Rules: Prepare a consolidated request containing only unresolved gaps and their rationale. Request minimum necessary data through an approved channel.
Systems_Evidence: Client communication channel and case workspace
Handoff_Dependency: Client response returns to evidence review; Sales/RM involvement to validate.
Pain_or_Value: Value hypothesis: Receive one clear request explaining the remaining information needed.
Root_Cause_Hypothesis: Request ownership and requirement rationale may be dispersed.
Human_Boundary: MVP: human approves external release. Target: automatic release remains disabled until explicit policy delegation.

User_Objective: Know which gaps are closed and what happens next.
Client_RM: Respond to specific follow-up questions if evidence remains insufficient.
Case_Manager: Track blockers and coordinate the next accountable action.
KYC_Operations: Assess received evidence and record unresolved gaps.
Product_Rules: Check evidence completeness and provenance; propose closure or a reasoned rework loop. Record versions and decisions; changed context can reopen affected requirements.
Handoff_Dependency: Make suitable evidence available downstream; keep unresolved blockers visible.
Pain_or_Value: Value hypothesis: Know which gaps are closed and what happens next.
Root_Cause_Hypothesis: Weak version/context links may obscure why a gap was reopened.
Human_Boundary: MVP: designated reviewer accepts evidence or requests remediation. Target: ambiguous sufficiency or material change escalates; S2 cannot grant trade clearance.
